decision.reason: [ev-7a3fdefaaff7] only says the service account template was fixed "to incorporate boolean values for the annotations". It doesn't say what happened to boolean annotation values before the fix: the chart might have failed to render, dropped them silently or converted them. That before-state decides the answer. If such values used to break rendering, no running environment can have them and the consequence is none. If they were silently dropped, the ServiceAccount annotations change on upgrade and behavior-change fits. Deciding needs PR #7698's description or a rendered-chart diff showing the pre-fix behaviour, and the proposed "previously mishandled" wording and medium severity aren't supported as stated.
